layman_headline: Market fear is easing but no new opportunities are ripe enough to pick right now.
layman_explanation: We're holding two positions — Solana and Chainlink — both slightly underwater but well within our stop-loss levels. The broader crypto market is in a 'Fear' state at 34/100, which is improving from last week's 29. The swing trade candidates on the board are either wildly overbought after massive runs (CYS up 64% in 24 hours, AKE up 152% in a week) or stablecoins with no trade opportunity. There's no clean, low-risk entry right now worth adding to the portfolio.
layman_action: Stay patient. Both current positions are active and within plan. Don't chase coins that have already surged 50-150%. Wait for a proper pullback setup or a fresh catalyst on a quality asset.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates with significant moves (CYS RSI 81, AKE +152% 7d, VELVET +144% 7d, H +71.5% 7d) are severely extended and carry extreme correction risk — classic blow-off top profiles with no RSI or MACD data to confirm continuation. UNI dropped 18% in a week but is down 92.8% from ATH, indicating structural weakness rather than a bounce opportunity. SOL and LINK remain within their trade plans; LINK's 12.3% weekly gain with high volume is encouraging but already in portfolio. Fear & Greed improving from 29 to 34 is a positive trend, and institutional news (Paul Tudor Jones adding BTC ETF shares, Israel's largest bank offering crypto) supports a gradually improving environment. Best course is to let existing trades work.
risk_factors: BTC remains weak at -3.1% weekly, and a breakdown below $60K could drag all altcoins including SOL and LINK to stop-loss levels
Fear & Greed at 34 is improving but still in Fear territory — sentiment can reverse quickly on macro news
SEC tokenization delays and regulatory uncertainty could suppress altcoin recovery timelines
watch_list: BTC price action around $62K support — a break below $60K would trigger defensive action on all positions
LINK volume continuation — sustained volume above $400M would confirm the breakout thesis toward $10.90 target
Fear & Greed index crossing above 40 into 'Neutral' territory as confirmation of sentiment recovery
market_context: The crypto market is in a cautious recovery phase with Fear & Greed improving from 29 to 34 but still firmly in 'Fear.' BTC is consolidating near $63K with institutional inflows (PTJ adding BTC ETF shares) providing a floor, but altcoins remain broadly depressed with most 70-90% off ATHs.
context_banner: Market fear is easing and institutional signals are constructive, but existing positions need to prove themselves before adding new risk.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 34 improving from 29 last week — sentiment is recovering but not yet bullish enough to justify chasing extended moves.
CYS RSI at 81 is deeply overbought, ruling out the strongest mover as a viable swing entry due to elevated correction risk.
Paul Tudor Jones adding 109K BlackRock BTC ETF shares and Israel's largest bank launching crypto trading signal growing institutional adoption that supports medium-term bullish bias.
LINK trading $476M in 24h volume with +5.5% daily gain suggests genuine buying interest rather than a dead cat bounce.
'Fear is fading across markets' headline aligns with improving sentiment data, suggesting the worst of the recent drawdown may be behind us.
